title: Pendel: your agent audits your project

points.text: Pendel is Russian slang for "a kick in the pants".
If your agent doesn't support a zone (hooks, for example), it should say so in the report.
The first line matters: auditing and fixing are separate steps.

outline.heading: The rule: fix three, not everything

points.text: The report may turn out long.

outline.heading: How to check that a fix didn't break anything

points.text: If there are uncommitted changes, commit them separately first.
This is a retelling of a reader's review of a third-party starter kit for Claude Code, not our measurement.
